exposure: unknown medication use during early pregnancy
history of maternal khat chewing in early pregnancy
cohort: 754 neonates (live and stillbirths) delivered at Jimma University Medical Center
finding: The prevalence of overt congenital anomalies was 4.1% (411 per 10,000 births), with unknown medication use, maternal khat chewing, and maternal chronic illness being associated with increased risk, while folic acid use was protective.
